statement: xpad creates an LED-class device xpadN on wired/wireless Xbox 360, uses 3-byte 01 03 mode command for wired and distinct 12-byte receiver command for wireless, and assigns a pad-number LED segment. xpad's LED class is an independent USB driver integration, not automatically provided by a standard HID uinput endpoint.

applicability.revision: pinned community Free60 ab1fe19, protoR2 4c0d062, x360w a8ac630; Linux 4056b3c; SDL 535d80b and 829a65d; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: xpad.c 1650-1760 and xpad_init_input / teardown. FF and LED output are separate features, not a single uinput FF promise.
